title: about me
text:
Background
I’m a computational physics major at Brigham Young University-Idaho with a heavy interest in applying machine learning and statistical models to better understand and model complex problems. I’m passionate about understanding not only the machine learning workflows but also the physical systems so that I can build solutions that are better taylored for real world problems. ## experience I am comfortable with python, R and C++, and have experience in building AI systems using pytorch and keras. I study physics at BYU-i and work as the physics lab coordinator and a TA, helping to tutor students to better understand complex physics topics. for a more detailed look at my projects feel free to check out the subpages above!
